blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — More than 17,000 police personnel will be deployed nationwide on Monday as the Philippines marks the 54th anniversary of the declaration of Martial Law, the Philippine National Police (PNP) said. Sept. 21 also marks the anniversary of the Trillion Peso March, when various sectors staged mass protests over alleged corruption in government flood-control projects. The deployment includes 8,553 personnel from the National Capital Region Police Office (NCRPO), 465 from Regional Support Units and 1,000 from the Reactionary Standby Support Force.
